name: Governance Forum Role
description: Seat roles on a governance forum. A taxonomy with behaviour: the flags below are read by quorum, voting and attestation logic, so an administrator can add a seat role without a code change.

fields.label: Code
fields.description: Stable identifier. Used by integrations and imports; do not reuse a retired code.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Inactive values stay on historical records but are not offered for new ones.

fields.label: Sort Order
fields.description: Presentation order where alphabetical is wrong.

fields.label: External Code
fields.description: The identifier this value carries in whatever system of record eventually owns it. Reserved now so a future reconciliation needs no migration.

fields.label: Counts Toward Quorum
fields.description: Whether a holder of this seat is counted when quorum is evaluated.

fields.label: Votes By Default
fields.description: Whether a holder is entitled to vote unless the membership row says otherwise.

fields.label: Can Attest
fields.description: Whether a holder of this seat receives an inventory attestation task.

fields.label: Is Chair Role
fields.description: Marks the presiding seat. At most one active holder per forum.

fields.label: Is Owner Role
fields.description: Marks the accountable-owner seat, which is distinct from the chair.

fields.label: Maximum Holders
fields.description: Seat cardinality cap. Zero or empty means unlimited.
